name: Misaki Shiina
source:
School: 2nd year Moriyoh Gakuen
Description: she is always working hard
Profile: She's very good at gymnastics, and she's very hardworking and 
dedicated to make herself better so that one day she can become famous.  She is very strong-minded, and she isn't agressive towards romance. She is very careful about guys and believes in platonic love.
